title: Basilisk: The Kouga Ninja Scrolls
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: When Shogun Ieyasu Tokugawa dissolves a centuries-old truce, ten ninja each from the feuding Iga and Kouga clans must fight to the death to decide the next shogun's heir, with the surviving clan to rule for a thousand years. Oboro of Iga and Gennosuke of Kouga are in love and are forced onto opposite sides. Adapted from Futaro Yamada's novel.
life_message: Inherited hatred and blind obedience to authority destroy love and life; the story is a tragedy of loyalty misused.

content.note: ANN calls the violence 'graphic' and action 'brutal', including blood-draining powers; MU Blood and Gore, Torture, Murder/s.

folkways.japan: Set in early Tokugawa Japan, it reflects historic clan (ie) loyalty and obedience to the shogun, which the story treats as tragic.
